title: ★360° Rooftop Patio★ 8bds! 10min to DT!
description:
This is the home for your Nashville adventure! An exquisitely decorated new build located in East Nashville, this 3 story home features 
- A roof top patio
- 3 Smart TV's
- Garage Parking
- Decked out Kitchen
- Self Check in
- 2 Covered patio's
- Fully Sanitized in between every stay
and so much more!

The space
The space
This beautiful new build features the following:

*Full sanitization in between each and every stay

*A fully furnished and equipped Kitchen

*High speed WIFI and Cable

*Coffee maker with coffee provided

*Keyless Entry

*Rooftop Patio with a wet bar and plenty of seating

*Washer and Dryer w/ no extra cost

*8 very comfortable beds, including a King in the master

*3 full bathrooms and a Master, plenty of space for everyone to get ready!

*2 car garage and room for 2 additional cars outside

*Dining table, perfect for family dinner

*TV’s in the living room and every bedroom

*Rooftop Patio + two other outdoor patios with seating and a dinner table 

*10 minutes or less to downtown, famous 5 points of East Nashville, Nissan Stadium, Grand Ole Opry, Top Golf, and so much more!

Guest access
You will have access to the entire home, it's all yours!

Other things to note
Absolutely no parties involving guests not listed on the reservation (will result in an immediate termination of your booking with no refund whatsoever). 
The home is 3 levels, so please be aware that if you have trouble with stairs, this home may not be perfect for you.
